questions.question: To what does Hosea 7 compare Israel?
options: A faithful servant and a wise and very prudent elder
A fruitful spreading vine and a sturdy old oak
A half-baked cake and a silly dove without sense
A mighty roaring lion and a high-soaring eagle
questions.answer: A half-baked cake and a silly dove without sense

questions.question: What does Hosea 7 say the people do not do, even in trouble?
options: Gather a great army together to defend the whole land
Make a binding treaty with the powerful king of Assyria
Offer all of the proper sacrifices upon the holy altar
Cry to God from the heart; they do not return to him
questions.answer: Cry to God from the heart; they do not return to him

questions.question: Hosea 7 says Ephraim mixes himself with the peoples and is a cake not turned.
Ephraim is like a _____, silly and without sense, calling to Egypt and Assyria.
They do not cry to me from the heart, but they wail upon their _____.
